name: atlas-ops-reporting
description: Use when a task asks you to produce an operational reporting result written to answer.json for the "Atlas Commerce Operations" workplace — e.g. a fulfillment cutoff scorecard, a refund/settlement reconciliation, a carrier-quality correction, a warehouse-productivity review, a support-health review, or any similar request that pairs a business request-payload JSON with an answer_template JSON Schema and a governed SQL data service. It guides you to read both contracts, discover the real schema, translate business definitions into precise read-only SQL (eligibility windows, quantifiers, FX conversion, medians, active-time clocks, ordering/tie-breaks, rounding, status/risk bands), apply a minimal approved correction with an audit row through the controlled transaction interface when one is requested, and emit an answer that conforms exactly to the template.
